description: User service deploy upgrades psycopg2 from 2.9.3 to 3.0.0 which has breaking API changes, causing all database calls to fail

known_root_cause.description: Dependency upgrade psycopg2 2.9.3 -> 3.0.0 removes cursor.mogrify() and changes connection pool API. All DB calls in UserRepository fail with AttributeError.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: psycopg2 3.0.0 breaks UserRepository.get_user() with AttributeError: cursor.mogrify removed in 3.x after deploy-usr-447
